news.text: 🇫🇷🧐 "There had been talks of #Juventus for #Bakola, but it was never a serious negotiation: for #Sassuolo he was always considered non-transferable - it wasn't a matter of money, but strictly about the opportunity. Whether he is being monitored is a separate issue: the bianconero management always keeps an eye on talented players like him, but at the moment it stops here."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇲🇪👀 "For #Adzic, there was an important offer from Germany, but #Juventus chose not to consider it, not to cash in on him and send him on a controlled loan to #Sassuolo for €500,000 + a €12M option to buy + a €1.7M counter-option to eventually bring him back. The management is very pleased with his start: I believe this is a buy-back clause on which they already have very clear ideas for the future."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰🆙 "#Zhegrova stayed because no solution was found on the mercato. #Lazio was never a serious option, while #Atalanta consisted it, but an agreement on the formula was never reached. There was also the #AlIttihad option, but they made other choices. This was the reasoning that led to his exclusion from the UEFA list: the management was convinced they would manage to sell him, but they didn't succeed."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲✅ "At this moment, the message coming from #Juventus is one of absolute control over the situation regarding #Spalletti. It is clear that the bianconero club, including the coach, hoped and wished for a better start, but the management is absolutely not questioning the coach's work."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

THIS IS NOT #JUVEBeaten in the 94th minuteIt ends 3-2 in Reggio Emilia: Lucio's squad loses controlThey come back twice but then lose to #SassuoloA second half completely devoid of logic. #Esposito surprises #Vicario. Then #Zhegrova, #Bowie and again the Kosovar score. The goal by the ex #Adzic decides it.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

LUCIO DO SOMETHING!#Juve, a crazy KO at the 94th minute against #Sassuolo after #Zhegrova's double comeback. Insult following injury: the 3-2 winner by #Adzic.The Kosovar's 2-2 equalizer at the 91st minute triggered a reckless assault that cost them their first defeat. #Spalletti: "We attacked with 8 players to try and turn it around by any means necessary. I was the one who urged the boys on, perhaps they took it too literally...". But the slip-ups, both individual and collective, are worrying, while #Kolo has become a problem: remedies are urgently needed. [Front Page TuttoSport]
